necessary_constructions: A,B,C,D = construct_square_q(12), E = construct_on_tline(C,A,D), E = construct_eqdistance(B,C,A)
proof:
Solution:
1. Square(A,B,C,D) => Angle_A_D_C - pi/2 & Length_A_B - Length_A_D & Length_A_B - Length_C_D & Length_A_C - Length_B_D & Angle_B_C_D - pi/2
2. Angle_A_D_C - pi/2 => Perpendicular(A,D,C,D)
3. Perpendicular(A,D,C,D) & Perpendicular(A,D,C,E) => Parallel(C,D,C,E)

5. Collinear(C,D,E) => Parallel(C,D,D,E)
6. Perpendicular(A,D,C,D) & Parallel(C,D,D,E) => Perpendicular(A,D,D,E)
7. Perpendicular(A,D,D,E) => Angle_A_D_E - pi/2
8. Angle_A_D_E - pi/2 => Area_A_D_E - Length_A_D*Length_D_E/2
9. Length_A_B - 12 & Length_A_B - Length_A_D => Length_A_D - 12
10. Length_A_B - Length_C_D & Length_A_B - 12 => Length_C_D - 12
11. Length_A_C - Length_B_D & Length_A_C - Length_B_E => Length_B_D - Length_B_E
12. Length_B_D - Length_B_E => IsoscelesTriangle(B,D,E)
13. Angle_B_C_D - pi/2 => Perpendicular(B,C,C,D)
14. Perpendicular(B,C,C,D) & Parallel(C,D,D,E) => Perpendicular(B,C,D,E)
15. IsoscelesTriangle(B,D,E) & Length_B_D - Length_B_E & Collinear(C,D,E) & Perpendicular(B,C,D,E) => Midpoint(C,D,E)
16. Midpoint(C,D,E) => Length_C_D - Length_D_E/2
17. Length_C_D - 12 & Length_C_D - Length_D_E/2 => Length_D_E - 24
18. Area_A_D_E - Length_A_D*Length_D_E/2 & Length_A_D - 12 & Length_D_E - 24 => Area_A_D_E - 144
